description: This HTML file is a test page for performance testing of doubleclick event handling in Leaflet maps. It sets up a map with OpenStreetMap tiles, populates it with markers, and measures the time taken to add markers with event handlers.

methods.name: getEventHandler
methods.description: Returns an event handler function that updates the 'perf' element with the marker index and event type.

methods.name: getRandomLatLng
methods.description: Generates a random LatLng within the bounds of the map.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Adds 100 markers to the map at random locations within current bounds and attaches a doubleclick event handler to each. Measures the time taken to add markers.

methods.name: logEvent
methods.description: Logs the event type to the console (unused in current code).
